contract: POST /api/items/:id/match runs Scanner.quickMatchLibraryItem for one accessible item with the string options provider, title, author, isbn and asin plus the boolean overrideCover and overrideDetails; it is not admin-only but the middleware still requires item access and the update permission. The response is the match result itself: {updated:boolean, libraryItem:expanded item} on a provider hit, or {warning:'No <provider> match found'} when the search returns nothing; a successful update moves updatedAt, persists the changed fields and cover and emits item_updated.
exceptions: Provider results come from a loopback custom metadata provider; the built-in internet providers are not exercised.
force is applicable (overrideCover/overrideDetails body options) and is asserted by match-override-replaces-cover-and-details.
